test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('pp_small_files/csv_{{_partition_id}}.csv', CSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') PARTITION BY a % 100 SELECT number, concat('str', toString(number % 997)), number / 7 FROM numbers(25000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('pp_small_files/tsv_{{_partition_id}}.tsv', TSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') PARTITION BY a % 100 SELECT number, concat('str', toString(number % 997)), number / 7 FROM numbers(25000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('pp_small_files/json_{{_partition_id}}.jsonl', JSONEachRow, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') PARTITION BY a % 100 SELECT number, concat('str', toString(number % 997)), number / 7 FROM numbers(25000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('pp_small_files/large.csv', CSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') SELECT number, concat('str', toString(number % 997)), number / 7 FROM numbers(600000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(a), sum(cityHash64(a, b, c)) FROM file('pp_small_files/csv_*.csv', CSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(a), sum(cityHash64(a, b, c)) FROM file('pp_small_files/tsv_*.tsv', TSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(a), sum(cityHash64(a, b, c)) FROM file('pp_small_files/json_*.jsonl', JSONEachRow, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(a), sum(cityHash64(a, b, c)) FROM file('pp_small_files/csv_*.csv', CSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') SETTINGS input_format_parallel_parsing = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(a), sum(cityHash64(a, b, c)) FROM file('pp_small_files/large.csv', CSV, 'a UInt64, b String, c Float64') SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
